description: This file is a shell script used for testing repository version checks and associated git configuration behaviors. It appears to set up test repositories, run various git commands, and verify expected outcomes, indicating its role in testing or automation within a git-related project.

methods.name: check_allow
methods.description: Checks if the current git repository uses the default git directory.

methods.name: check_abort
methods.description: Ensures that the command to get the git directory fails, indicating no repository present.

methods.name: mkconfig
methods.description: Creates a mock git config in a directory with specified repository format version and extensions.
